observations: I opened assets/panels/01-1.png, workflow/review/page-01.png and all five character sheets (main-cast, nurse, checkin-patients, pharmacy-lab, vision-cast) with Read and looked at them myself.

The panel is a wide, eye-level exterior of a whitewashed clinic in morning sun. It has a teal awning, terracotta pots with red hibiscus and a leafy plant, palms and a lane at far left, and yellow flowering branches at top right. It reads as a Tamil Nadu neighbourhood clinic.

Dr. Ananya stands in the glass doorway, left of centre, and matches main-cast.png: low dark bun with loose strands, gold stud, calm almond eyes, teal kurta under an open white coat, stethoscope around her neck (not in use), dark leggings and flat sandals. Her mouth is open in a warm greeting.
Her hands match production. Her left hand (screen-right, since she faces the viewer) is out with the palm open, ushering the patient in. Her right hand hangs empty at her side. Her fingers are clean.

An elderly woman in a lilac sari is seen from behind stepping toward the door. At right, two patients sit on grey perforated metal chairs, also seen from behind, so no detailed faces are drawn, as the scene asks. None of the new pharmacist or lab technician designs appear, which is correct for this section.
The binder spines, wall frames, window and desk phone show no readable text.
On page-01.png the caption box sits on the empty top-left wall and sky band. It does not touch Ananya's face, her gesturing hand or the patient.
Limitation: I did not open source/original.txt or storyboards/page-01.svg. My judgement rests on the request JSON, the panel PNG, the lettered page and the character sheets.
I opened assets/panels/01-2.png, workflow/review/page-01.png and main-cast.png with Read and looked at them.

Meera matches main-cast.png: round face, large round eyes, thin high brows, a side braid with a teal tie over her left shoulder (screen-right), a blue block-print kurta, and a silver bangle on her right wrist.

Her hands match production. Her left hand holds the beige corded receiver to her left ear (screen-right) and the coiled cord runs to the desk phone. Her right hand, the one with the bangle, writes in an open register with a pen. The fingers and the pen grip are clean.

A tall stack of registers sits at left and a queue of patients is seen from behind in the foreground. There is a sweat drop and small ring lines by the phone. Her expression is flustered but friendly, matching the emotion note.
The register pages are ruled but blank, the phone keypad buttons are unmarked, and the book spines are plain. There is no readable text.
On page-01.png both balloons sit in the empty upper wall. The tails end at the top of her head. Her face, both hands, the phone, the pen and the open register stay clear.

Her hands match production: both hands type on the keyboard of a silver laptop, and the fingers are well formed.

The laptop screen shows a three-step progress dot row, blank rounded fields (the first has only a thin cursor bar), abstract blocks and a teal button. There are no letters, numbers or logos. The binder spines on the shelf are blank.
Evening light comes through the window (sunset sky, trees), and a mug sits on a cork coaster. Both match the scene and the time-change transition.
The stethoscope is not visible from this rear angle. That is plausible for a view from behind, so I do not treat it as a continuity break.

Minor: the scene text says the camera is 'behind her right shoulder', but the image shows her left side (left ear and stud) as she faces right. The intended look (over the shoulder, laptop at three-quarter view) is achieved, so this is not an issue.

Mr. Raman matches checkin-patients.png: short white hair, bushy white brows, round glasses, prominent ears, a long face with smile lines, a cream half-sleeve shirt and grey trousers. He stands at the counter, smiling.
His hands match production. He is turned toward screen-right, so his right side is nearer. His near (right) hand grips the wooden walking stick, and his far (left) hand rests on the counter.

Meera sits behind the desk and types with both hands on the keyboard. The monitor is angled toward her, so only its back is visible. Her braid, bangle and blue kurta match her sheet, and she greets him warmly.

The background is the tidy reception from the section notes: a QR stand with an abstract block pattern, a wall TV with a teal screen and an empty white strip, a vitals table with a cuff and a small monitor showing abstract blocks, and two waiting patients seen from behind in grey and dark brown. None of these show readable text or numbers.

Possible minor point: at this display size I may see a small dark dot on Meera's cheek. Her sheet has no mole (a beauty spot is Priya's trait). It is tiny and I could not confirm it at full resolution, so I record it as an observation rather than an issue. A 200% check is suggested.
